mapper.select: select sum(f.sale_count) "value", c.category_name "name" from (select id, fresh_name, category_id, sum_repertory - repertory as 'sale_count' from fresh where is_deleted = 0) f inner join category c on f.category_id = c.id group by c.category_name;

select id, fresh_name "freshName", feature, description, picture_address "pictureAddress", prices, promotion_price "promotionPrice", is_recommend "isRecommend", sum_repertory - repertory "salecount" from fresh_system.fresh where is_deleted = 0 order by salecount desc limit 0,29
select *, category.id from fresh where is_deleted = 0 and is_recommend = 1
SELECT * FROM fresh WHERE is_recommend = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
